scope: Planning annotations for existing evidence; no original reading, obligation, method receipt or legal status is altered.

research_families.name: Exact product question and output
research_families.problem: Duty applicability, fulfillment under an adopted reading, and overall compliance answer different questions.
research_families.intervention: Reconstruct question-to-result trace and distinguish these outputs.
research_families.closure: Each output identifies its question and premises; a duty-trigger result cannot answer a fulfillment question.

research_families.name: Paragraph 10 meaning
research_families.problem: Retention, exercised conduct and achieved adequacy remain rival readings; their legal equivalence is unproved.
research_families.intervention: Compare source arguments and distinguishing situations; preserve distinct standards.
research_families.closure: A particular relation is established within a stated premise set, or the rival and precise missing warrant remain explicit.

research_families.name: Time and continuing responsibility
research_families.problem: Assessment interval, provider succession, historical records and incident/recovery effects combine normative rules with dated events.
research_families.intervention: Separate temporal legal rules from the factual chronology and expose interval coverage.
research_families.closure: Defined relation between each actor/duty and interval, or an exact missing rule/event; no edition-date substitution.

research_families.name: Authority, applicability and modality
research_families.problem: Source editions, scheme conditions, capacities, incorporation, modifications and SHOULD do not automatically establish binding consequences.
research_families.intervention: Trace applicability and modality separately from source retrieval.
research_families.closure: Every applied authority has a scoped link or remains conditional; no unsupported general transfer.

research_families.name: Evidence and evaluative standards
research_families.problem: A recorded event or a supplied Boolean does not establish adequate supervision, sound operations or proper records.
research_families.intervention: Expose observable inputs, interpretation premises and independent sufficiency assumptions.
research_families.closure: A scoped derivation has an explicit rule or identifies its missing criterion; no opaque legal answer accepted as established fact.

research_families.name: Ownership, incidents and remediation
research_families.problem: Ledger records, legal/beneficial title, finality, materiality and cure depend on further law and facts.
research_families.intervention: Separate these legal relations and trace their dependencies.
research_families.closure: Only the specified property or incident consequence follows under supported or expressly assumed premises.

research_families.name: Paragraph 14 and footnote 5
research_families.problem: Trigger, object and standard differ across the A/B/C proposals; agreement on request alone is insufficient.
research_families.intervention: Trace each clause and test one dimension at a time.
research_families.closure: Any claimed conditional equality covers the named dimensions; unresolved attachment remains visible.

research_families.name: Use of case authority
research_families.problem: Quotations, holdings, material facts and applicability transfer are different steps; Gatecoin does not directly decide the SFC questions.
research_families.intervention: Inspect exact source roles and reasons for each proposed transfer before using a case to discharge a premise.
research_families.closure: Case-derived claims retain their role, source and target-specific transfer premise; missing reasons/treatment stay qualified.

decisions.decision: Use paragraph 10 fulfillment under explicit competing readings as the main diagnostic, with p14/fn5 attachment and Gatecoin transfer as bounded companion cases.
No additional runtime capability is prioritized until tied to a specific named failure or necessary conditional representation.
Legal text is a premise. Human/model agreement, raw test counts and formula counts do not establish English correctness.

not_established: Exact equivalence among similarly worded readings
Exhaustiveness or disjointness of the proposed research families
That a complete necessary-and-sufficient legal test exists
